name: quandora-staging
description: Staging Quandora plugin with Factor Mining, Strategy Building, and Paper Trading skills for pre-release workflow testing.

interface.shortDescription: Use staging Quandora services from your agent.
interface.longDescription: Quandora Staging packages Factor Mining, Strategy Building, and Paper Trading skills in one plugin. Paper Trading discovers eligible source runs, starts and monitors single-strategy or static-sleeve Portfolio Paper runs, reads PnL/history/code, and terminally stops confirmed runs.
defaultPrompt: Use Quandora Staging Factor Mining to show public tasks.
Use Quandora Staging Factor Mining with my custom factor idea.
Use Quandora Staging Strategy to combine existing factors into a cross-sectional strategy.
Use Quandora Staging Paper Trading to select an eligible source run and start a simulated run after confirmation.
